first_storyboard.title: How A R N I Helps Your Heart

scenes.narration: Hello, I’m Dr. Smith. Today we’ll talk about how an A R N I can help your heart.
scenes.visual_description: Doctor and patient sitting, friendly consultation.

scenes.narration: An A R N I combines a blood‑pressure blocker with a medicine that widens arteries and removes extra salt, making it easier for your heart to pump blood.
scenes.visual_description: Doctor shows a simple heart model and a pill bottle.
scenes.on_screen_text: How A R N I works

scenes.narration: Ask your doctor if switching from your current ACE inhibitor to an A R N I could lower your risk of hospital visits and death.
scenes.visual_description: Doctor points to a decision‑aid chart on a tablet.
scenes.on_screen_text: Consider an A R N I
